item.title: Puratos Acquires Vör Foods To Expand Clean Label Nut Butters And Fillings In The U.S.
item.description: Puratos announced it has acquired Vör Foods, adding a fast-growing producer of ultra-clean label nut butters and nut-based fillings to its portfolio and expanding its U.S. manufacturing footprint. The deal, announced on January 21, 2026, brings Vör’s Trevose, Pennsylvania-based operation into the Puratos network as the company seeks to accelerate sweet goods innovation and respond more quickly to shifting consumer tastes. item.description: Sense, a Cambridge, Massachusetts-based provider of grid-edge intelligence software, announced it has received a strategic investment from Analog Devices (ADI) to accelerate the development of scalable technologies that help utilities and grid operators improve reliability and visibility across the distribution network. item.title: Evaro: $25 Million Series A Raised to Expand Embedded Digital Healthcare For Consumer Brands
item.description: Evaro, an NHS licensed digital healthcare platform that says it serves more than 2 million patients, has raised a $25 million Series A round led by AlbionVC, with participation from Simplyhealth Ventures, Exceptional Ventures, Cornerstone VC, and BBI. The company positions itself as a healthcare-as-a-service provider that enables consumer brands, healthcare organisations, and employers to offer regulated digital care without building their own clinical or pharmacy infrastructure. item.description: Adaptive6 emerged from stealth with $28 million in Series A funding, bringing its total capital raised to $44 million as the company pushes an engineering-first approach to cloud cost governance that it says can reduce overall cloud spend by 15% to 35%.
